links.outcome: Readability of chatbot pediatric anesthesia responses versus recommended sixth-grade level across seven indices
links.effect: None of the four chatbots achieved the recommended sixth-grade readability level on any of the seven readability indices; reliability and readability correlations were non-significant.
links.quote: None of the evaluated models achieved the recommended sixth-grade readability level across any index.

screen.reason: Evaluated the baseline reliability and readability of four commercial LLM chatbots on 18 pediatric anesthesia queries reflecting parental needs without testing a deployment intervention or safeguard.
